tasks.label: Sprout · Firebase · Distribute Development APK
tasks.detail: Build development APK and upload to Firebase App Distribution
tasks.command: set -euo pipefail; FIREBASE_APP_ID="${FIREBASE_APP_ID:-$(python3 -c "import json; from pathlib import Path; data=json.loads(Path('android/app/src/development/google-services.json').read_text()); print(next(c['client_info']['mobilesdk_app_id'] for c in data['client'] if c['client_info']['android_client_info']['package_name']=='app.stackmint.sprout.dev'))")}"; flutter build apk --flavor development -t lib/main_development.dart && firebase appdistribution:distribute build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-development-release.apk --app "$FIREBASE_APP_ID" --groups default
